description:
Zero to One by Peter Thiel and Blake Masters argues that the real progress is going from zero to one, not copying from one to n. This is a summary, analysis and review of its main ideas: monopoly on a secret, why competition is for losers, and why first mover advantage is weaker than it looks.

What happens in the book, what it means, and the reading most people miss. The chapters below follow the narration in order.
